descriptionChirho: The king of Moab who hired the prophet Balaam to curse Israel during the wilderness wanderings (Numbers 22-24). All occurrences — nominative, with prepositions (to/from Balak), and with conjunctions — refer to a single individual. Multilingual evidence unanimously confirms one referent: eng 'Balak', spa 'Balac', hin 'बालाक', arb 'بَالَاق', kor '발락', swa 'Balaki'.
